chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Grandson and Sylvia's acting
summary: Milt and the Barkers talk about their grandson's music, Milt's daughter's piano lessons, and Sylvia, who writes poems and acts.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Does your grandson like any music?
He fooled around with the guitar a little while, but...
Does he.
Danny got him a fiddle, and a...I don't know about the guitar.

Same with my kids. I tried to get Charlotte into music, and she was trying to practice that piano, and I was hollering, 'That's an F-sharp, not F-natural,' and the tears was coming. And she's wondering how I knew it was F-sharp, and I'm way upstairs, you know. And one day, Mona said to me, 'Hey, everybody can't be a musician.' I mean, it turned off my daughter.
Well, Sylvia's got the (?). She acts.
Oh yeah!
Barker - V-48
She always did do ...(?)...
Sylvia likes to (?).
We bought her a piano, but she didn't play. Got Swanson's dad as a teacher. You know Swanson?
Swanson!
Piano player.
Yeah!
His dad used to come down here to ...(?)... Nice little West Indian man.
But now she's with that show business, you know.
That's great.
She loves it.
That's wonderful. They have to find their own place.

That's right. Exactly. And she writes poems and she writes songs, and she's interested in everything in the music. And she belongs to this big theatre there, you know, and then when comes here, right away she's going to the southern(?) theatre and all this... I mean, she loves that.
Well, that's so good, to see her keep this relativity there...
She's got this one-woman thing, you know.
Barker - V-49
And Danny, you've got to add your grandson to this list. I don't see his name down here, you know.
Grandson?
He's got to be in here somewhere... I mean, Sylvia...
I've just got the ones that play.
But Sylvia has a beautiful voice. Sylvia can sing. But she'd rather act now than to sing.
I tried to be honest, and just put the ones up who actually paid some dues.
